source_contract: unchanged allocation/fill/transform/reduction/release algorithms; modular narrowing is independently proved after the independently proved guarded reduction
candidate_rule: one deterministic guarded-reduction plus unsigned modular-narrowing proposal, full BYTE_SUM_LIMIT; no candidate or compiler-flag selection using measurement results
holdout_status: new fixed disclosed size/seed distribution; disjoint from this PGO training and previous primary holdout inputs; not a concealed benchmark population
ordering: rotate kernels by group; rotate backends by group plus original kernel index; reverse odd groups
request_ordering: after bulk loop; size index=(probe*7+3)%size_count, seed index=(probe*3+2)%seed_count; same order for every arm and group
primary_gate: all scheduled samples correct/stable/complete, all14 candidate/baseline comparisons satisfy mean95upper, batchp95, requestp95, requestp99 and peakRSS thresholds; report strong10-comparison subset separately
tail_scope: nearest-rank observed single-call p95/p99 and batch tails, not a population tail bound or service SLO; clock overhead recorded separately without subtracting or censoring observations
rss_scope: post-exec Linux VmHWM of common native driver and one loaded backend; contains harness/runtime and is not owner-only heap memory
native_loading: parent snapshots exact artifact to sealed memfd; child checks all seals and actual dlsym function mapping device/inode/file extent before execution; parent binds measurement to sealed artifact SHA
pgo: Clang instrumentation for both kernels on training inputs only; actual profraw merge and profile-use LTO rebuild; no training on holdout or reuse of old profiles
compiler_configuration: Clang O3 fullLTO generic x86-64; Rust1.95 O3 fatLTO onecodegenunit panicabort x86-64; standalone HIA directLLVM O3 x86-64; exact tools and commands bound before sampling
cost_accounting: measure each deterministic proposal and full fresh proof/build API; include all production path proof/emission/compiler/identity/publication work; keep parent intervals separate from nested phases; charge PGO training and rebuild to its arm; record benchmark driver/setup/correctness/measurement/archive costs separately
cold_start_scope: actual builds using existing installed tools and source caches, not a newly provisioned machine
break_even: descriptive point estimate from extra fully measured candidate preparation divided by average per-call saving; null when no positive saving; not a guaranteed deployment threshold
failure_policy: all112 scheduled samples retained, no trimming, discarded rounds, adaptive repetition, changed thresholds or retiming to pass; failed build/proof prevents native sampling for that arm and fails quality
registration: source/driver/protocol/tool hashes frozen in separate REGISTRATION.json before first training or performance request; final sampling requires exact hash match
